in_arabic.name: جميلة
in_arabic.meaning: جميلة تعني الجمال الحسن في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم جميلة مشتق من الجذر العربي ج-م-ل، ويعني الجمال الحسن، والجميل هو الذي يتصف بالجمال، وقد وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران: {وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۚ إِنَّ السَّمْعَ وَالْبَصَرَ وَالْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُولَٰئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْئُولًا} آية ۲۸، وفي هذا السياق، يدل اسم جميلة على المرأة الجميلة التي تتصف بالجمال الداخلي والخارجي.

in_urdu.name: جمیلہ
in_urdu.meaning: جمیلہ کا مطلب خوبصورتی حسن ہے اردو میں
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام جمیلہ عربی جذر ج-م-ل سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورتی یا حسن، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں خاص طور پر مقبول ہے، اور اسلامی تقویم میں اس کا ذکر جميلة بنت الحارثة سے ملتا ہے، جو رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے صحابی تھے۔

in_english.name: Gamila
in_english.long_meaning: The name Gamila originates from the Arabic root 'ج-م-ل' (jamal), meaning beauty or lovely. It is mentioned in Islamic tradition and is associated with positive attributes such as inner and outer beauty. Gamila is used across various Muslim cultures to signify a person with charming characteristics.

data.cultural_impact: The name Gamila holds a significant cultural importance in the Islamic world as it is a unique and beautiful name that originated from the Arabic language. The name Gamila is derived from the Arabic word "jamal" which means camel. The name is given to a girl and is a symbol of beauty, strength, and elegance, just like the camel. Camels have been an essential part of the Islamic culture due to their use as a means of transportation in the desert regions of the Middle East. Therefore, the name Gamila reflects the rich cultural heritage of the Islamic world.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Gamila holds a deep spiritual significance in Islam as it reminds us of the unique qualities of Allah (swt) that are reflected in the creation of the camel. The camel is a unique creature that can survive in extreme desert conditions, providing sustenance, transport, and shelter. The name Gamila highlights the creative power and wisdom of Allah (swt) in designing such a remarkable creature. Moreover, the name Gamila can also be interpreted to mean "the one who is kind and beautiful in nature," reminding us of the qualities that we should strive to embody in our daily lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Young Camel" symbolizes The One Who Is a Young Camel. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Gamila serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of young camel.
